slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to maximize total revenue from producing and selling all four products (steel, engines, electronics, plastic) domestically, subject to the production caps and labor limit, with imported goods simply purchased at world prices as needed?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective, and the user simulator confirmed it is to maximize domestic GDP.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot, H1 (P0), was resolved before the agent declared READY_TO_MODEL; the remaining parked items were not hidden slots in the benchmark.

summary: The agent explicitly asked about the missing objective and received confirmation that the goal is to maximize domestic GDP, then appropriately stopped after resolving the only P0 hidden slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
